description: Composite risk score from 0 to 1, higher is riskier, built from regulatory, liquidity, team and audit inputs; components.sources names where each input came from. meta.status is partial when inputs are missing, listed in meta.diagnostic.missing (regulatory usually is), unseeded when none is available and stale when the score is over 48 hours old. An unknown entity is an error (HTTP 404). Starter tier.
name: get_risk_score
